comparator.name: Bachelor Industrial Design
comparator.sourceNotes: Current permitted revisit on 2026-11-13. Exact English-taught full-time BSc Industrial Design, ordinary September 2026 entrant cohort, with no formal specialisations. The current ordinary diagram and after-revision PER PDFs are byte-identical to the prior reviewed sources. All 23 diagram positions total 180 EC (60/60/60): 120 core + 10 ITEC + 50 elective EC, including the 25 EC external learning activity within elective space. The formal PER Article 3.4(3), p22, instead states 125 core EC, Article 3.4(5) separately gives two 5 EC ITEC units, and Appendix 2 p76 requires 50 elective EC (20 in Year 2 and 30 in Year 3), together 185 EC. Article 3.4(8) requires at least 45 elective EC, which does not reconcile Appendix 2. The same PER cohort diagram p78 and current curriculum diagram support 120 core EC, without an explicit correction or precedence for the conflicting text. Appendix 3 MyFuture, sustainability-assessment and calculus pilots do not change these aggregate credits. Current Forms and Files and the PER landing page distinguish after-revision entrants from before-2023 and the separate 2025 cohort diagram. Newly read current Examination Committee Regulations p16 explicitly delegates approval of 50 elective EC for 2023–2024 and later entrants; this corroborates the elective volume but does not amend 125 core EC or reconcile the total. Individual approval/exemption powers are not assumed as a credit waiver. No 5 EC is subtracted or invented. Preserve independent rules: three 5 EC PPD courses, embedded MyFuture pilot and five noncredit SG activities; ELA requires appropriate prior approval and is not a universal internship. BEP entry after 120 earned EC including compulsory Year 1 and DPB240, DCB200, 3PHYS and DLB385 plus signed PlanApp approval; the full assessment table has further course/elective requirements and the partial display is not an entry checklist. Project/PPD progression and all 59 interest judgments, 14 qualified discovery attributions and the actual feasible 24-course internal research remain valid. Publicly retain the 20 named components totalling 130 EC (60/40/30), excluding the conflicted elective space. Full pathway, UCR comparability and final stopping decision remain unapproved pending authoritative reconciliation.

Art3.4(8)atleast45elective would close180 but Appendix2/guide require50. Need authoritative amendment, explicit precedence or reconciliation; do not silently subtract5 or combine cohorts.
exception.curriculumContext: Current ordinary September 2026 diagram has 23 unique positions totalling 180 EC (60/60/60): 120 core, 10 ITEC and 50 elective EC. This remains a diagnostic allocation because formal Article 3.4 specifies 125 core EC while Appendix 2 specifies 50 elective EC. No complete formally reconciled pathway is certified. Current source versions and the cohort boundary were checked again in the permitted revisit. PPD comprises 15 credited EC; MyFuture is embedded under the pilot and five SG activities are noncredit. The 20 EC final project and 25 EC external learning space retain their documented entry/approval conditions; an internship is not universally required. Valid interest and UCR research remains provisional pending credit reconciliation.

audience.programmeDescription: This English-taught TU/e degree combines technology, creativity, user research and business to design interactive products, systems and services. Design projects and a personal development portfolio connect its areas of expertise.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The published degree credit requirements conflict, so a complete pathway and UCR comparison cannot yet be confirmed. This does not establish that UCR has no relevant programme.

curriculum.limitation: The named components shown total 130 EC: 60 in year 1, 40 in year 2 and 30 in year 3. Electives and external learning activities are omitted because the published total credit requirements conflict. This is an incomplete degree pathway; a complete UCR comparison awaits clarification.

componentNotes.DLB384: The personal and professional development learning line comprises three credited 5-EC courses across the degree. MyFuture activities are integrated into this line; at least five Studium Generale activities are also required without additional credits.
componentNotes.DPB390: The final design project requires at least 120 earned credits, the compulsory first-year components and specified second-year courses, together with an approved study plan. Additional course and elective requirements apply; this partial curriculum is not an admission checklist.
